newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU probes Marseillaise de Credit recapitalisation.
newsitem.headline: EU probes Marseillaise de Credit recapitalisation.

text.p: The European Commission on Wednesday requested detailed explanations from the French government concerning the recapitalisation of state owned bank Societe Marseillaise de Credit by some 2.0 billion french francs, EU sources said.
The sources said the Commission had been informed of a restructuring plan in 1994 under which Marseillaise de Credit had received a state injection of 860 million French francs.
But the Commission was aware that the bank had obtained two other capital increases of 1.2 billion in 1994/95 and a further 850 million planned for 1996.

Given that information, which the Commission had gleaned mainly from press reports, it was obvious that additional information was needed to decide on the restructuring plan for the regional bank which is to be privatised.
